title: Kissed Garlicky Vietnamese Napa Cabbage Ca Kho To
description: A garlicky, fluffy, and comforting Vietnamese dish featuring Napa cabbage, this Whole30-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is broiled to perfection and served in a ca-kho-to form.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, coconut aminos, sesame oil, salt, black pepper, and chili flakes.
Add the minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the Napa cabbage leaves to the bowl and toss to coat with the garlic sauce.
Transfer the cabbage mixture to a baking dish and broil for 5 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and stir the cabbage to ensure even cooking.
Return the dish to the oven and broil for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cabbage is tender and slightly caramelized.
Remove the dish from the oven and serve the ca-kho-to hot.
